Digital Realty's SEC property schedule classifies 1125 Energy Park Drive as a data center acquired in March 2005, documenting earlier use at the same address long before H5's acquisition.

rationale: H5's current St. Paul operation is dated no later than January 31, 2021, but state records document a separate downtown computing and storage facility by 1984 and an SEC filing documents data-center use at 1125 Energy Park Drive by March 2005. The H5 acquisition event cannot be Ramsey County's first entry. The complete historical inventory remains unresolved.

Google and Lancaster records establish the exact Fairfield County data center operating by 2023. The reviewed evidence does not establish a complete historical county inventory or exclude earlier institutional and private operations, so the true first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.finding: Akron's 2011 annual statement reports that AT&T's new $120 million data center became operational in fall 2010, two years before Involta opened.

rationale: The mapped Involta/ark Akron facility opened in 2012, but the City of Akron documents AT&T operating a separate city data center by 2010. Involta therefore cannot be Summit County's first entry. The complete historical inventory remains unresolved.

The Nation's project records establish a support data center in the Durant headquarters complex operating by 2018. Reviewed historical material indicates earlier computing activity in Bryan County but does not resolve a discrete earlier data-center facility or a complete inventory, so first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.canonical_name: Lucent Technologies data center at 7725 West Reno
earlier_operational_findings.finding: Contemporaneous reporting states that RACK59 was installed in space that had previously served as a Lucent data center; the former plant was vacant and acquired by its developers in 2004.

rationale: RACK59 reports operation since 2009, but contemporaneous local reporting documents prior Lucent data-center use in the exact space before the plant became vacant and was acquired in 2004. The RACK59 event cannot be Oklahoma County's first entry; the earlier commissioning date and complete inventory remain unresolved.

The selected Wilsonville building resolves to the Mentor Graphics/Siemens corporate data center, with construction complete and opening expected in December 2012 and current operation independently confirmed. The reviewed sources do not establish a complete Clackamas County inventory or exclude earlier corporate and public-sector operations, so first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.canonical_name: University of Pennsylvania ENIAC computing room
earlier_operational_findings.finding: The University of Pennsylvania history documents ENIAC calculations running in Philadelphia in November 1945, decades before Terminal Commerce became a carrier hotel.

rationale: Terminal Commerce was operating as a carrier/data-center building by 1998 and remains operational, but University of Pennsylvania records document room-scale ENIAC computing operations in Philadelphia in 1945. The 1998 event therefore cannot be the county's first computing-facility entry; the complete historical inventory remains unresolved.

DC BLOX's exact Horry County cable landing station opened on October 10, 2023. The reviewed operator and local development records establish the facility and date but do not provide a complete county inventory or exclude earlier enterprise, telecommunications, or public-sector computing facilities, so first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.canonical_name: Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility predecessor systems
earlier_operational_findings.finding: ORNL documents the OLCF computing bay and predecessor high-performance systems from 2004, well before Frontier's 2022 launch.

rationale: Frontier's official launch supplies a dated 2022 operational anchor, but ORNL's institutional history documents the OLCF computing facility and predecessor systems beginning in 2004. Frontier cannot be Roane County's first entry, and the county's complete earlier computing-facility inventory remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.canonical_name: Microsoft Texas Research Park data-center campus
earlier_operational_findings.finding: Contemporaneous reporting described SAT46 as a new building at Microsoft's existing Texas Research Park data-center campus, establishing earlier campus operation before SAT46's 2022 completion.

rationale: TRP3/SAT46 resolves to an operating Microsoft data-center building with a 2022 year anchor. The contemporaneous project record describes it as an addition to an existing Texas Research Park data-center campus, so SAT46 cannot be the county's first entry; the earlier campus commissioning date and complete inventory remain unresolved.

The SEC-filed company record establishes Cedarvale operation since 2023, the operator documents active mining in its first new 50 MW building in 2024, and the Texas Comptroller independently lists the project. These sources do not establish a complete Ward County inventory or exclude earlier computing facilities, so first entry remains unresolved.

Strata currently markets the exact Vernal data center, and a city-filed proposal establishes operation no later than May 17, 2022. The original commissioning date, earlier local carrier computing infrastructure, and complete Uintah County inventory remain unverified, so first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.finding: The county budget directs installation of additional cooling in the courthouse data center by the end of 2009, establishing an earlier operating computing facility.

rationale: CSSNW is documented at the exact mapped address by December 2023, but Whatcom County's 2009–2010 budget required additional cooling in an already existing courthouse data center. The CSSNW date therefore cannot be county first entry; the complete historical inventory remains unresolved.

Municipal minutes resolve the exact We Energies Pewaukee Data Center and establish operation by May 16, 2013. The reviewed evidence does not establish the original commissioning date, exclude earlier utility or institutional computing facilities, or complete the county inventory, so first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.finding: The city-hosted National Register report states that the Mayflower Building opened in 1965 for electronic data-processing systems and outside data-center services.

rationale: Equinix dates its first Infomart data center to 2000, but the City of Dallas historic record documents the Mayflower Building's purpose-built electronic data-processing spaces and outside data-center tenants from 1965. The Infomart event cannot be Dallas County's first computing-facility entry.

Google's official location history resolves the Bridgeport campus and dates its first data-center opening to 2018. The reviewed evidence does not establish a complete Jackson County inventory or conclusively exclude earlier institutional, industrial, or telecom computing operations, so first entry remains unresolved.

earlier_operational_findings.finding: UC Irvine documents its first IBM 1410/1440 computer system and computer facility operating in 1965.

rationale: The operating Santa Ana OCiX/TPx colocation facility is documented by May 31, 2011, but UC Irvine records its first campus computer system in 1965 and a dedicated ICS Computer Center by 1968. The 2011 facility cannot be Orange County's first computing-facility entry.

earlier_operational_findings.canonical_name: Fort Lauderdale City Hall Data Center
earlier_operational_findings.finding: Fort Lauderdale's FY 2014 adopted budget identifies an existing City Hall Data Center undergoing UPS and server-space renovation.

rationale: Peak 10's Fort Lauderdale facility is operationally dated by October 18, 2016, but the city's FY 2014 budget documents an existing municipal City Hall Data Center. The 2016 commercial facility cannot be Broward County's first computing-facility entry.

Cologix resolves the exact JAX1 facility and dates its acquisition as an existing data center to September 2013. The reviewed evidence does not establish a complete Duval County inventory or conclusively exclude earlier institutional, industrial, or telecom computing operations.

Peak 10 documents the mapped Louisville East building as an operating data center by January 9, 2017. The reviewed evidence does not establish a complete Jefferson County inventory or conclusively exclude earlier enterprise, institutional, or telecom computing operations.

Operator and contemporaneous trade sources resolve CyberNAP in Glen Burnie and date its department-store conversion to 2012. The evidence does not establish a complete Anne Arundel County inventory or conclusively exclude earlier computing facilities.

Liquid Web identifies Lansing as its original data-center region and founding location established in 1997. The reviewed evidence does not establish a complete Eaton County inventory or conclusively exclude earlier institutional, government, industrial, or telecom computing operations.

The building operator resolves 165 Halsey Street and dates its full operation as a data center and carrier hotel to 1999. The reviewed evidence does not establish a complete Essex County inventory or conclusively exclude earlier mainframe, institutional, industrial, or telecom computing facilities.
